title: Roof Inspection Estimate Worksheet
subtitle: Residential Roof Inspection: prices observed scope, options, and exclusions.
description: Roof Inspection Estimate Worksheet covers roof covering, flashing, penetration, drainage edge, attic indicator, and affected interior area. The roof inspection coordinator records Residential Roof Inspection observed scope, costs, options, and terms. Roof Inspection Estimate Worksheet keeps Residential Roof Inspection exceptions visible until the roof inspection coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Roof Inspection Estimate Worksheet at residence, roof plane, edge, penetration, attic area, and reported leak zone. Document roof covering, flashing, penetration, drainage edge, attic indicator, and affected interior area identity before Residential Roof Inspection begins. Compare roof covering, flashing, penetration, drainage edge, attic indicator, and affected interior area findings with stated Residential Roof Inspection criteria; route unresolved Residential Roof Inspection issues to qualified roofing reviewer. For Roof Inspection Estimate Worksheet, confirm requirements for Residential Roof Inspection. Ask qualified roofing reviewer to review Residential Roof Inspection conditions beyond the roof inspection coordinator's role.

sections.title: Property estimate review and customer identity
sections.guidance: Identify the customer, asset or property, estimator, and basis date before pricing the work.

blocks.label: Residential Roof Inspection identity

fields.label: Roof type, approximate age, slope, and area
Weather event, leak history, prior repair, and access method

blocks.guidance: Use the Residential Roof Inspection identifier printed on roof covering, flashing, penetration, drainage edge, attic indicator, and affected interior area or its linked source record.

sections.title: Pricing options and customer decision inputs
sections.guidance: Price the observable work and options. Keep concealed conditions and unconfirmed quantities out of fixed scope.

blocks.label: Residential Roof Inspection scope observations
items: Covering wear, displacement, breakage, and fastening indication
Flashing, valley, penetration, wall, and transition condition
Ridge, edge, gutter, downspout, and drainage path
Sealant, membrane, coating, and visible repair condition
Attic, deck, insulation, staining, and moisture indication
Ground or limited-access observation and unobserved scope
blocks.guidance: Mark what was observed or supplied as estimate input; explain anything material that could not be inspected.

sections.title: Estimate exception and change conditions
sections.guidance: State what could change the price, timing, method, or scope before the customer or responsible party decides.

blocks.label: Conditions that may require a revised estimate or specialist review
items: Unsafe slope, weather, surface, ladder, or edge condition
Active structural movement or collapse concern
Concealed moisture extent cannot be determined
Temporary protection or qualified escalation needed
blocks.guidance: Pause Residential Roof Inspection and notify roof inspection coordinator when safe access, weather, structural stability, water entry, or required qualified assessment remains unresolved.

sections.title: Estimate decision and selected service scope
sections.guidance: Record the selected option and spending limit. Approval of an estimate authorizes only the stated scope and terms.

blocks.label: Estimate support retained
blocks.guidance: Attach or link proof for roof covering, flashing, penetration, drainage edge, attic indicator, and affected interior area; mark only Residential Roof Inspection evidence present in that record.
